body:

[muwu] We need a new Ozbargain certified way of directly comparing protein powders! 🤔
I propose, the unitised $ per 30g protein.
Taking this deal as the example.
$81 per 1.8kg
$45 per 1.0kg
65.6% protein
$45 per 656g (0.656kg)
$2.05 per 30g
To compare, let's take the recent Musashi deal that was quite popular, where people were getting the 100% Whey Vanilla 2kg price-beat @ CW for $69.44:
$69.44 per 2.0kg
$34.87 per 1.0kg
77.9% protein
$34.87 per 779g (0.779kg)
$1.34 per 30g
So, this deal is 53% more expensive.
Now make that a mandatory requirement in the description of protein powder deals? 😶
